title: Demo: Patentability and novelty overview
content: Demo evidence: patent-oriented analysis commonly considers novelty, inventive step and industrial applicability. This record is illustrative demo content and must be verified against current official sources.

title: Demo: Traditional knowledge and patent investigation
content: Demo evidence: an innovation involving traditional knowledge may require investigation into provenance, prior disclosure and relevant Indian frameworks. This record is illustrative demo content.

title: Demo: Biodiversity and ABS consideration
content: Demo evidence: innovations based on biological resources can require a biodiversity and access-and-benefit-sharing review. Exact obligations depend on the facts and applicable current law.

title: Demo: Trademark basics
content: Demo evidence: trademarks can protect signs used to distinguish goods or services. Distinctiveness and conflicts with earlier marks are important investigation areas.

title: Demo: WIPO and international IP pathways
content: Demo evidence: WIPO resources can help users understand international IP systems and filing pathways. Country-specific requirements must be checked with the relevant authority.

title: Demo: PCT pathway
content: Demo evidence: the Patent Cooperation Treaty provides an international filing framework. A PCT filing does not itself grant a worldwide patent; national or regional procedures remain relevant.

title: Demo: Copyright overview
content: Demo evidence: copyright generally concerns original expression rather than an abstract idea. Exact scope depends on the work and applicable law.
